product.description: Elegant 1.6L Oval Glass Buffet Warmer with Stainless Steel Stand & Lid Add an elegant touch to your dining table with this beautiful 1.6-liter oval buffet warmer. Featuring a clear glass serving dish, polished stainless steel stand, and matching stainless steel lid, it is perfect for serving food beautifully while helping keep it warm during gatherings, parties, and special occasions.
